lines.translation: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.
The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ne naau soee jin jaasee aape saach driRaaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||
The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.
The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: tribhavan saach kalaa dhar thaapee saache hee pateeaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; with Truth He is pleased. ||11||
Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin sojhee kinai na hoee ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: saach milai so saache bhaae naa veechhuR dukh paaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||
Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.
They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vadiaaee mel na pachhotaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: He blesses those whom He forgives with glorious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |
| He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape mukat daan mukateesar mamataa mohu chukaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||
I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.
You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa apanaa karanee kaar karaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||
They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh te upajahi tujh maahi samaavahi ||
lines.translation: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee mil saache sukh paaidaa ||16||2||14||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained. ||16||2||14||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.
There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa din rain na cha(n)d na sooraj su(n)n samaadh lagaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanee na baanee paun na paanee ||
lines.translation: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.
There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d pataal sapat nahee saagar nadee na neer vahaaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||
There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.
There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: narak surag nahee ja(n)man maranaa naa ko aai na jaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||
There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.
No one was seen, except the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naar purakh nahee jaat na janamaa naa ko dukh sukh paaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ||4||
There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.
There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam bhekh na koee naa ko naath kahaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam naa brat poojaa ||
lines.translation: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.
No one spoke or talked in duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap upaai vigasai aape keemat paaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||
There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.
There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)d na koee naa ko va(n)s vajaaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||
There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.
Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai dhiaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)d bi(n)d nahee jeeu na ji(n)do ||
lines.translation: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.
There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naa tad giaan dhiaan kul opat naa ko ganat ganaaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9||
